statement: A floor tile is shaped like parallelogram $ABCD$. Angle $A$ measures $(2x + 8)^\circ$ and angle $C$ measures $(4x - 30)^\circ$. What is the measure of angle $B$?

choices.misconception: I solved $2x + 8 = 4x - 30$ to get $x = 19$ and stopped there, giving $x$ instead of an angle.
I found angle $A = 46^\circ$, but I thought consecutive angles of a parallelogram add to $90^\circ$, so I got $90 - 46 = 44$.
I found angle $A = 46^\circ$ and assumed angle $B$ was equal to it, but only opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal.

hints: Angles $A$ and $C$ are opposite angles. What is true about opposite angles of a parallelogram?
Set the opposite angles equal to find $x$ and angle $A$. Angles $A$ and $B$ are consecutive, so they add to $180^\circ$.
$2x + 8 = 4x - 30$ gives $x = 19$, so angle $A = 46^\circ$. Now subtract from $180^\circ$.

solutions.reliable: Opposite angles of a parallelogram are equal, so $2x + 8 = 4x - 30$, which gives $38 = 2x$ and $x = 19$. Then angle $A = 2(19) + 8 = 46^\circ$, and angle $C = 4(19) - 30 = 46^\circ$ as well. Consecutive angles of a parallelogram are supplementary, so angle $B = 180^\circ - 46^\circ = 134^\circ$.
